name: Accrual v1.3.26
changelog: Restorasi arsitektur URL Scheme terbukti (accrual://add) dengan komit instan ke Supabase dan Dynamic Island HUD
Pemisahan 5 preset mandiri: Pemindai Layar, Dialog Pintasan, Notifikasi Bank, Dikte Suara, dan Pemindai Struk
Pembersihan tombol unduh berkas .shortcut lokal yang rusak, digantikan dengan Tautan Resmi iCloud dan tombol salin skema URL 1-ketuk
Pembaruan ScanPaymentScreenshotIntent dengan openAppWhenRun = true untuk responsivitas instan
changelog_en: Restored proven URL Scheme architecture (accrual://add) with instant Supabase commits and Dynamic Island HUD capsule
Split shortcuts hub into 5 standalone presets: Screen Scanner, Glass Dialog, Bank Notifications, Voice Entry, and Receipt Scanner
Eliminated broken raw .shortcut file download buttons, replaced with verified official iCloud links and 1-tap URL scheme copiers
Updated ScanPaymentScreenshotIntent with openAppWhenRun = true for instant foreground responsiveness
